passive.name: Leverage
passive.description: Renata's Attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Renata's allies can damage marked enemies to deal bonus damage.

primaryAbilities.name: Handshake
primaryAbilities.description: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Renata sends out a missile from her arm, Rooting the first enemy hit for {{ rootduration }} second and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

Recast: Renata Pulls the enemy in a direction, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies they are thrown into and Stunning for {{ stunduration }} seconds if the thrown enemy is a champion.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Bailout
primaryAbilities.description: Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death and potentially saving them if they get a takedown.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Renata infuses an ally champion, granting {{ ascalc }} Attack Speed and {{ mscalc }} Move Speed towards enemies, increasing to {{ finalascalc }} Attack Speed and {{ finalmscalc }} Move Speed over {{ duration }} seconds. Takedowns refresh the duration of the buff.

If the ally would die, they instead return to full Health, which then decays over 3 seconds.

If they get a Takedown while decaying, they will be set to {{ triumphpercent }}% max Health and stop decaying.

The Champion's death can be delayed by healing or similar effects while in the decaying state, but cannot be prevented unless the Champion gets a Takedown. Champions can only delay their death once.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Loyalty Program
primaryAbilities.description: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, shielding allies and damaging and slowing enemies hit.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> surrounding enemies and enemies hit by 30% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Allies hit gain <shield>{{ shieldcalc }} Shield</shield> for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Hostile Takeover
primaryAbilities.description: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, Berserking enemies for {{ berserkduration }} seconds, causing them to Attack the nearest unit, prioritizing their allies.

While Berserk, enemies gain {{ bonusattackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

allSpellRecords.name: Leverage
allSpellRecords.summary: Renata's Attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Renata's allies can damage marked enemies to deal bonus damage.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Renata's Attacks mark enemies for [6] seconds and deal an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.01, perLevel=0.0012, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.0002) × AP] max Health magic damage if they were unmarked.

Allied champions' Attacks or Abilities consume the mark, dealing [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.01, perLevel=0.0012, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.0002) × AP] max Health magic damage.

Renata may only have one target marked at a time.
